.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]

* [REACH compliance management][78]

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

# The trusted global distributor and development partner for ingredients and specialty chemical
# solutions

At Caldic, partnerships come first. We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to enable
them to bring breakthrough innovations to market across the life science and material science
sectors. By combining technical expertise, local presence and a people-driven mindset, we go beyond
supply chain excellence to spark what’s next in healthier living and sustainable materials. 

[Explore our solutions][37]

## We go beyond distribution to co-create solutions that enable our customers to create entirely new
## product categories.
* ### Co-create tailored solutions
  
  We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to develop tailored solutions grounded in deep
  technical, market, and local expertise.
* ### Breakthrough innovations
  
  With over 70 application laboratories worldwide, our R&D teams co-create formulations that deliver
  superior quality and greater market value.
* ### Beyond supply chain excellence
  
  Our advanced supply chain facilities deliver custom-blended and packed solutions that reduce
  complexity, accelerate speed-to-market and get high-quality products production-ready.
* ### Global reach, local precision
  
  With teams in 44 countries, we combine global sourcing with local delivery to scale fast and meet
  market demands with deep insight and technical agility.

By connecting our market insight and entrepreneurial mindset with our deep customer understanding,
we develop tailored solutions across food, (bio)pharma, personal care and industrial applications.
From formulation to delivery, every detail reflects our care. With insight and agility, we help
simplify supply chains and unlock value at every step. 

[Discover our market solutions][39]

With teams in 44 countries and facilities across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific, we combine
global sourcing with local last-mile delivery. Our on-the-ground experts build strong customer
relationships and respond with speed, insight and precision. From sourcing and reformulating to
blending, labeling and resizing, our regional agility drives growth in dynamic, fast-moving markets.
We deliver fast, custom solutions - from bakery mixes to specialty pharma-grade solvents for nearby
hospital hubs.

registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with

# Adipic Acid

Tradeasia International Pte. Ltd. established in 2002 and is headquartered in Singapore is a global
chemical supplier and trading organization providing integrated chemical procurement services with a
level of certainty and trust, which makes Tradeasia stands unique. It was setup with the sole
intention of carrying out chemical distribution services especially to commodity industries in many
parts of the world.

[ Become Our Supplier ][23]

## Overview

Adipic acid is an aliphatic dicarboxylic acid with the formula (CH2)4(COOH)2. It is a white,
crystalline compound with a slight acid taste and very faint odor. Its solubility is very low in
water and soluble in organic solvents like alcohol and acetone. It is mainly as a precursor for the
production of nylon.

[ Show More ][24]

## Application

In food industry, adipic acid is added as main acid in bottled drinks, giving them a bubbly fizz. It
adds a tart flavor to fruit juice and gelatin. Found in many powdered food and drink, adipic acid
helps to intensify the sweet flavor. It also allows jams and jellies to hold their jiggle shape and
acts a leavening agent in baking powder, cake mixes and baked goods.

# Adipic Acid

Tradeasia International Pte. Ltd. established in 2002 and is headquartered in Singapore is a global
chemical supplier and trading organization providing integrated chemical procurement services with a
level of certainty and trust, which makes Tradeasia stands unique. It was setup with the sole
intention of carrying out chemical distribution services especially to commodity industries in many
parts of the world.

[ Become Our Supplier ][23]

## Overview

Adipic acid is an aliphatic dicarboxylic acid with the formula (CH2)4(COOH)2. It is a white,
crystalline compound with a slight acid taste and very faint odor. Its solubility is very low in
water and soluble in organic solvents like alcohol and acetone. It is mainly as a precursor for the
production of nylon.

[ Show More ][24]

## Application

In food industry, adipic acid is added as main acid in bottled drinks, giving them a bubbly fizz. It
adds a tart flavor to fruit juice and gelatin. Found in many powdered food and drink, adipic acid
helps to intensify the sweet flavor. It also allows jams and jellies to hold their jiggle shape and
acts a leavening agent in baking powder, cake mixes and baked goods.

# N2O Abatement Technology Licensing

Adi-*pure*® adipic acid sets benchmarks for quality, consistency and refinement. We partner with our
global customers, providing technical support and assistance with new product development
initiatives.



## What is Adi-*pure*®?

INVISTA Adi-*pure*® high-purity adipic acid is a crystalline, white powder that exhibits typical
carboxylic acid chemistry. With excellent uniformity and consistent end-use performance, Adi-*pure*®
adipic acid is a valuable intermediate for a wide range of applications, including:



as a monomer in nylon, paper additives, copolyamides, terpolymers and unsaturated polyester resins

in polymer additives for epoxy curing agents and plasticizers

as a chemical intermediate in the synthesis of polyesters/diesters, polyester polyols, adiponitrile,
cyclopentanone, 1,6-hexanediol and dimethyl sebacate

in solvents, lubricants, electronics, soil conditioners, glass protection agents, briquetting
agents, leather tanning agents, flue gas desulfurization scrubbers and cleaning aids

### Learn more about Adi-*pure*® through our technical data sheets.

## The Adi-*pure*® Difference

We strive to produce adipic acid to the highest specifications for proven quality that serves the
varied needs of our customers, and we offer customized solutions to meet specific requirements.

Our Adi-*pure*® adipic acid is produced at our Victoria, Texas, facility and can be packaged for

## Applications

Our Adi-*pure*® adipic acid is used in a wide range of end products. Here are some of the most
popular uses. *Not all applications of Adi-pure® adipic acid have been listed on this website. For
more details on other applications, please** [contact us][8].*

Polyamides

Nylon, a class of aliphatic polyamides, is the single largest commercial application for Adi-*pure*
high-purity adipic acid. Nylon 66 and nylon 6 are the most economically important nylons. Both can
be converted to fibers, used for carpets, apparel, tire cord and industrial applications, or to
engineering resins, used for automotive parts, electrical and electronic applications, machine
parts, films, wire coatings and monofilament.
 

Polyurethanes

Polyurethanes (PUs) are among the most versatile plastics available today, offering different
properties suitable for many end uses. PUs are available in several forms, each with different
potential applications. Most PUs are produced from the reaction of either a polyester or polyether
polyol with a diisocyanate and chain extender to give a variety of physical and chemical properties.
 

Plasticizers

A plasticizer is a substance which when added to a material (usually a plastic), makes it flexible,
resilient and easier to handle. Modern plasticizers are man-made organic chemicals, the majority of
which are diesters produced from high-molecular-weight alcohols such as adipic and phthalic acid.
 

Tabletting

An excipient is an inert or inactive substance that is used in tablets as a filler, binder,
lubricant or disintegrant. Adi-*pure* adipic acid from INVISTA is ideally suited for use as an
excipient in tablet manufacture, as it can play a number of roles in the tablet.
 

Paper Additives

Adipic acid is used extensively in the manufacture of polyamide-epichlorohydrin wet-strength resins.
Similar products can also be manufactured using dimethyl adipate or other adipate esters.
 

Unsaturated Polyester Resins

Unsaturated polyester resins are the third-largest class of thermoset molding resins. These
polyesters are low-molecular-weight viscous liquids dissolved in vinyl monomers like styrene to
facilitate molding or shaping of the resin into a desired form before curing to rigid solids.
Adi-*pure* adipic acid improves tensile and flexural strength in these resins and, at high levels,
can give soft, pliable products for specialty applications.

Synthetic lubricants are man-made formulations of chemicals that increase the performance and
productivity of machinery. Most synthetic lubricants are made from polyalphaolefin or ester-based
fluids and an additive package. The proportion of base fluid can be up to 75% of the formulation.

Synthetic lubricants are man-made formulations of chemicals that increase the performance and

Because synthetic lubricants are composed of structurally uniform molecules with well-defined
properties, they offer advantages over conventional oil and greases.
 

Chemical Intermediate

Adi-*pure*® adipic acid can be used for the synthesis of a range of chemical intermediates, include
adiponitrile, the key intermediate for manufacturing of 1,6-hexanediamine; cyclopentanone, an
intermediate used in the synthesis of flavour and fragrance chemicals, glutaric acid and
biologically active compounds; 1,6-hexanediol, a valuable chemical intermediate used in polyester
polyol, urethane and alkyd resin manufacture; and dimethyl sebacate, from which sebacic acid can be
easily prepared.
 

Sequestrants

Sequestrants are employed in a diverse range of products and processes – from household products to
industrial applications. Sequestrants are used to sequester metal ions such as iron, copper, nickel,
cobalt, chromium, calcium and manganese by forming strongly associated but soluble complexes with
metal ions. These metal ions find their way into products as a result of, for example, hardness in
water, directly from the soil or as a contaminant in raw materials.

## Applications

Our Adi-*pure*® adipic acid is used in a wide range of end products. Here are some of the most
popular uses. *Not all applications of Adi-pure® adipic acid have been listed on this website. For
more details on other applications, please** [contact us][8].*

Polyamides

Nylon, a class of aliphatic polyamides, is the single largest commercial application for Adi-*pure*
high-purity adipic acid. Nylon 66 and nylon 6 are the most economically important nylons. Both can
be converted to fibers, used for carpets, apparel, tire cord and industrial applications, or to
engineering resins, used for automotive parts, electrical and electronic applications, machine
parts, films, wire coatings and monofilament.
 

Polyurethanes

Polyurethanes (PUs) are among the most versatile plastics available today, offering different
properties suitable for many end uses. PUs are available in several forms, each with different
potential applications. Most PUs are produced from the reaction of either a polyester or polyether
polyol with a diisocyanate and chain extender to give a variety of physical and chemical properties.
 

Plasticizers

A plasticizer is a substance which when added to a material (usually a plastic), makes it flexible,
resilient and easier to handle. Modern plasticizers are man-made organic chemicals, the majority of
which are diesters produced from high-molecular-weight alcohols such as adipic and phthalic acid.
 

Tabletting

An excipient is an inert or inactive substance that is used in tablets as a filler, binder,
lubricant or disintegrant. Adi-*pure* adipic acid from INVISTA is ideally suited for use as an
excipient in tablet manufacture, as it can play a number of roles in the tablet.
 

Paper Additives

Adipic acid is used extensively in the manufacture of polyamide-epichlorohydrin wet-strength resins.
Similar products can also be manufactured using dimethyl adipate or other adipate esters.
 

Unsaturated Polyester Resins

Unsaturated polyester resins are the third-largest class of thermoset molding resins. These
polyesters are low-molecular-weight viscous liquids dissolved in vinyl monomers like styrene to
facilitate molding or shaping of the resin into a desired form before curing to rigid solids.
Adi-*pure* adipic acid improves tensile and flexural strength in these resins and, at high levels,
can give soft, pliable products for specialty applications.
 

Synthetic Lubricants

Synthetic lubricants are man-made formulations of chemicals that increase the performance and
productivity of machinery. Most synthetic lubricants are made from polyalphaolefin or ester-based
fluids and an additive package. The proportion of base fluid can be up to 75% of the formulation.
Because synthetic lubricants are composed of structurally uniform molecules with well-defined
properties, they offer advantages over conventional oil and greases.
 

Chemical Intermediate

Adi-*pure*® adipic acid can be used for the synthesis of a range of chemical intermediates, include
adiponitrile, the key intermediate for manufacturing of 1,6-hexanediamine; cyclopentanone, an
intermediate used in the synthesis of flavour and fragrance chemicals, glutaric acid and
biologically active compounds; 1,6-hexanediol, a valuable chemical intermediate used in polyester
polyol, urethane and alkyd resin manufacture; and dimethyl sebacate, from which sebacic acid can be
easily prepared.
 

Sequestrants

Sequestrants are employed in a diverse range of products and processes – from household products to
industrial applications. Sequestrants are used to sequester metal ions such as iron, copper, nickel,
cobalt, chromium, calcium and manganese by forming strongly associated but soluble complexes with
metal ions. These metal ions find their way into products as a result of, for example, hardness in
water, directly from the soil or as a contaminant in raw materials.
 

Solder Fluxes

Solder flux and flux-cored solders are used to improve the quality of electrical connections by
cleaning connector surfaces and promoting metal-to-metal bonding. Adipic acid is used in a number of
flux and flux-cored solder formulations to activate the flux, promote metal cleaning and minimize
residual impurities and corrosion. The very low trace impurity levels of Adi-*pure*® high-purity
adipic acid make it highly desirable for high-quality electronics applications.

> # Adipic acid or Hexanedioic acid Pure and BP USP NF FCC Food Grade Manufacturers
> 
> **Adipic acid ****or Hexanedioic acid** is an alpha,omega-dicarboxylic acid that is the
> 1,4-dicarboxy derivative of butane. It has a role as a food acidity regulator and a human
> xenobiotic metabolite. It is also called hexanedioic acid. Adipic acid is a white crystalline
> solid with CAS number 124-04-9. It is used mainly in the production of nylon. It occurs relatively
> rarely in nature. It has a tart taste and is also used as an additive and gelling agent in
> gelatins. It is also used in some antacids to make them tart. Adipic acid has also been
> incorporated into controlled-release formulation matrix tablets to obtain pH-independent release
> for both weakly basic and weakly acidic drugs. It has a molecular formula C6H10O4 and molecular
> weight 146.14. It has a FEMA number 2011. Significant amounts of adipic acid are used as a food
> ingredient as a flavoring agent and gelling aid. It is used as food additive with E number E355.
> It can be described as a colorless white crystalline solid with sour taste and it is having a
> melting point of 151C to 154C and boiling point of 337C to 338C. It's flash point is 196 deg C
> (closed cup). It is slightly soluble in cold water and freely soluble in ethanol. It has a
> relative density of 1.36.
> 
> **Hazard statements:****
> **H319: Causes serious eye irritation.
> **Classification according to European Directive 67/548/EEC as amended**:
> Hazard symbol(s): Xi Irritant
> R-phrase(s): R36 Irritating to eyes.
> 
> Please click for [Adipic Acid or Hexanedioic acid Safety Data Sheer SDS MSDS Sheet][3].
> 
> **Specifications of Adipic Acid FCC Food Grade**
> Hexanedioic Acid; 1,4-Butanedicarboxylic Acid
> C6H10O4 Formula wt 146.14
> 
> **DESCRIPTION
> **Adipic Acid occurs as white crystals or a crystalline powder. It is not hygroscopic. It is
> freely soluble in alcohol, soluble in acetone, and slightly soluble in water.
> Function: Buffer; neutralizing agent.
> 
> More details on [Adipic Acid BP Ph Rur Grade manufacturers][4].
>

> Hexanedioic acid.
> 1,4-Butanedicarboxylic acid CAS 124-04-9.
> 
> Adipic Acid contains not less than 99.0 percent and not more than 101.0 percent of C6H10O4,
> calculated on the dried basis.
> 
> More details on [Adipic Acid USP NF Grade manufacturers][5].

>

> # Adipic acid or Hexanedioic acid Pure and BP USP NF FCC Food Grade Manufacturers
> 
> **Adipic acid ****or Hexanedioic acid** is an alpha,omega-dicarboxylic acid that is the
> 1,4-dicarboxy derivative of butane. It has a role as a food acidity regulator and a human
> xenobiotic metabolite. It is also called hexanedioic acid. Adipic acid is a white crystalline
> solid with CAS number 124-04-9. It is used mainly in the production of nylon. It occurs relatively
> rarely in nature. It has a tart taste and is also used as an additive and gelling agent in
> gelatins. It is also used in some antacids to make them tart. Adipic acid has also been
> incorporated into controlled-release formulation matrix tablets to obtain pH-independent release
> for both weakly basic and weakly acidic drugs. It has a molecular formula C6H10O4 and molecular
> weight 146.14. It has a FEMA number 2011. Significant amounts of adipic acid are used as a food
> ingredient as a flavoring agent and gelling aid. It is used as food additive with E number E355.
> It can be described as a colorless white crystalline solid with sour taste and it is having a
> melting point of 151C to 154C and boiling point of 337C to 338C. It's flash point is 196 deg C
> (closed cup). It is slightly soluble in cold water and freely soluble in ethanol. It has a
> relative density of 1.36.

production of acrylamide and its downstream chemicals. Which makes us the comprehensive supplier for
acrylamide chain chemicals in China . The downstream industries involved in papermaking auxiliaries,
textile printing and dyeing treatment, pharmaceutical intermediates, sewage treatment, coatings,
oilfield auxiliaries, adhesives, crosslinking agents, pesticides, etc. With the vertical extension

trade products horizontally to meet the diversified needs of customers.

Relying on the superior conditions in a famous chemical city in China, an efficient logistics

enterprises, our company has established long-term, extensive and win-win cooperative relationships

hundreds of users . It has mature sales channels and reliable partners abroad. The complete
equipment and excellent quality control of the entrusted factory enable us to meet the requirements
of customers. The cooperative factory has passed the ISO 9001-2015 and ISO 14001-2015
certifications, and all the products involved comply with national quality standards.

 

International innovative thinking, top technology in the industry, strong technicalstrength and high
brand value, achieved the glory and dream of Ruihai. The marketleading position will be further

## ELFAT^{TM} – CTO

Cetyl alcohol, also known as 1-hexadecanol, is a 16-carbon fatty alcohol used in cosmetics and
personal care products. It acts as an opacifier, emulsifier, and thickening agent while also
preventing skin dryness. It is deemed safe by the FDA for food and skin protectant use.

# Caustic Soda Flakes

## ELRASA^{TM} – CSF99

Caustic soda flakes, also known as sodium hydroxide flakes, are a solid form of caustic soda (NaOH)
that appear white and crystalline. Highly soluble in water, these flakes produce a strong alkaline
solution. As one of the most potent alkalis, caustic soda is extremely corrosive and widely
recognized for its versatility across industrial sectors. It remains one of the most essential
chemical compounds produced and supplied by leading caustic soda producers worldwide.

surfactant valued for its strong cleansing and foaming action with reduced irritation compared to
SLS, making it a workhorse ingredient in shampoos, body washes, hand soaps, dishwashing liquids, and
laundry detergents. Formulators planning a sodium laureth sulfate buy can source standard SLES 70%
in both 2EO and 3EO variants, with other active levels and customer-specific specifications

### What We Offer

##### Quality and Compliance

Our quality system adheres to ISO 9001 and GMP frameworks. Raw materials require verification of a
third-party Certificate of Accreditation (COA) upon arrival, and production processes follow
Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and batch records. All products come with a COA, MSDS, and TDS.

##### Technical Support

Leveraging the end-to-end production capabilities of our own certified factories, we can reliably
guarantee order delivery with a standard lead time of 30-45 days, and maintain regular inventory of
products. Furthermore, we can provide a complete set of export documents, including certificates of
origin and declarations of conformity, to help clients efficiently complete customs clearance at the
destination port.

##### Professional Support

Technical support covers the entire product introduction cycle:
1) Free samples provided;
2) Formula adjustment suggestions for issues such as agglomeration, dissolution rate, or purity;
3) Customized consultation and production based on your target specifications.

We integrate sustainable practices throughout our manufacturing processes, focusing on raw material
control, safe production, emission reduction, and regulatory compliance. Our facilities operate
under strict quality and environmental standards to ensure responsible and reliable chemical supply.

##### Quality and Compliance

third-party Certificate of Accreditation (COA) upon arrival, and production processes follow
Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and batch records. All products come with a COA, MSDS, and TDS.

##### Technical Support

Leveraging the end-to-end production capabilities of our own certified factories, we can reliably
guarantee order delivery with a standard lead time of 30-45 days, and maintain regular inventory of
products. Furthermore, we can provide a complete set of export documents, including certificates of
origin and declarations of conformity, to help clients efficiently complete customs clearance at the
destination port.

##### Professional Support

Technical support covers the entire product introduction cycle:
1) Free samples provided;
2) Formula adjustment suggestions for issues such as agglomeration, dissolution rate, or purity;
3) Customized consultation and production based on your target specifications.

# Willkommen am Institut für Systembiotechnologie

Die Biotechnologie hat das Potential, die industrielle Produktion zu revolutionieren – das Team um
[Prof. Christoph Wittmann][16] ist mittendrin. Wir entwickeln Designer-Zellfabriken zur
maßgeschneiderten Synthese biobasierter Produkte – von hochpreisigen Wirkstoffen für den
Gesundheitsbereich, über großvolumige Plattformchemikalien bis hin zu smarten Bio-Materialien. Dafür
optimieren wir Stoffwechselwege und deren Regulation in Mikroorganismen oder verleihen diesen auch
ganz neue Fähigkeiten – Ansätze des Metabolic Engineering und der Synthetischen Biologie machen dies
möglich. Unsere "Designer-Bugs" nutzen wir zur Entwicklung umweltfreundlicher und
ressourcenschonender Herstellungsverfahren. Die Synthese der Zukunft nutzt nachwachsende Rohstoffe –
wir auch.

# Willkommen am Institut für Systembiotechnologie

Die Biotechnologie hat das Potential, die industrielle Produktion zu revolutionieren – das Team um
[Prof. Christoph Wittmann][16] ist mittendrin. Wir entwickeln Designer-Zellfabriken zur
maßgeschneiderten Synthese biobasierter Produkte – von hochpreisigen Wirkstoffen für den
Gesundheitsbereich, über großvolumige Plattformchemikalien bis hin zu smarten Bio-Materialien. Dafür
optimieren wir Stoffwechselwege und deren Regulation in Mikroorganismen oder verleihen diesen auch
ganz neue Fähigkeiten – Ansätze des Metabolic Engineering und der Synthetischen Biologie machen dies
möglich. Unsere "Designer-Bugs" nutzen wir zur Entwicklung umweltfreundlicher und
ressourcenschonender Herstellungsverfahren. Die Synthese der Zukunft nutzt nachwachsende Rohstoffe –
wir auch.

## Küresel Ticari İstihbarat ve Analiz Hizmetleri

TurkExim'in dış ticarette neden en güvenilir iş ortağınız olduğunu keşfedin.

### Biz Kimiz?

TurkExim, dünya çapındaki 39'dan fazla ülkede ithalatçı ve ihracatçı firmaların doğrudan ve şeffaf
bağlar kurmasına olanak tanıyan küresel bir ticari istihbarat platformudur. Milyonlarca ham gümrük
beyannamesini işlenebilir ticari verilere dönüştürerek satış ekiplerinizin nokta atışı ihracat
hedeflerine ulaşmasını sağlıyoruz.

[ Çözümlerimizi Keşfedin → ][27]

### Konşimento Veritabanı (Bill of Lading)

TurkExim Konşimento Veritabanı, gümrüklerde kullanılan Armonize Sistem (GTİP / HS Code) kodlarına
göre sevkiyat analizleri sunar. Rakip firmaların hangi alıcılara, ne miktarda, hangi tarihlerde
yükleme yaptığını tam şeffaflıkla inceleyebilir ve tedarik zincirindeki hareketleri gerçek zamanlı
görebilirsiniz.

[ Konşimento Verilerini İnceleyin → ][28]

#### Bulunan Potansiyel Alıcı Analizleri

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.

  kanalları.

## Nylon Granules Benefits

Nylon granules are the raw material used to produce a wide variety of nylon products. They offer
several benefits over other materials, including:
* **Strength and durability:**Nylon is known for its high tensile strength, making it resistant to
  wear and tear. 
* **Lightweight:** Nylon is much lighter than metals, but still offers good strength. 
* **Versatility:** Nylon granules can be easily melted and molded into a wide variety of shapes and
  sizes. 
* **Heat resistance:** Nylon has a relatively high melting point, making it resistant to heat. 
* **Chemical resistance:** Nylon is resistant to many chemicals, including oils, greases, and
  alkalis. 
* **Low friction:** Nylon has a low coefficient of friction, which means that it slides easily
  against other surfaces. 
* **Cost-effective:** Nylon granules are a relatively inexpensive material, making them a good
  choice for mass production.

## Nylon Granules Application

Nylon granules, due to their versatility and range of properties, have applications in a vast number
of industries. Here are examples

[Automotive Industry]

### **Automotive Industry**

Nylon granules are used to manufacture a variety of automotive parts, including bumpers, dashboards,
interior trim panels, fan shrouds, and carpet fibers. They are lightweight yet strong, and can
withstand abrasion and wear.

[Electronics Industry]

### Electrical and Electronics Industry

Due to its good insulating properties, nylon is used in various electrical and electronic
applications such as circuit boards, connectors, wire insulation, and housing for electronic
devices.

[Construction Industry]

### Construction Industry

Nylon granules are used to manufacture plastic lumber, flooring underlays, pipes, conduits, and door
hardware. They offer good weather resistance, chemical resistance, and abrasion resistance.

[Textile Industry]

### Textiles and Apparel Industry

Nylon is a popular fiber used in clothing, carpets, and other textiles. Nylon granules are melted
and spun into fibers to create fabrics that are strong, durable, and wrinkle-resistant.

## Nylon Granules Benefits

Nylon granules are the raw material used to produce a wide variety of nylon products. They offer
several benefits over other materials, including:
* **Strength and durability:**Nylon is known for its high tensile strength, making it resistant to
  wear and tear. 
* **Lightweight:** Nylon is much lighter than metals, but still offers good strength. 
* **Versatility:** Nylon granules can be easily melted and molded into a wide variety of shapes and
  sizes. 
* **Heat resistance:** Nylon has a relatively high melting point, making it resistant to heat. 
* **Chemical resistance:** Nylon is resistant to many chemicals, including oils, greases, and
  alkalis. 
* **Low friction:** Nylon has a low coefficient of friction, which means that it slides easily
  against other surfaces. 
* **Cost-effective:** Nylon granules are a relatively inexpensive material, making them a good
  choice for mass production.

## Nylon Granules Application

Nylon granules, due to their versatility and range of properties, have applications in a vast number
of industries. Here are examples

[Automotive Industry]

### **Automotive Industry**

Nylon granules are used to manufacture a variety of automotive parts, including bumpers, dashboards,
interior trim panels, fan shrouds, and carpet fibers. They are lightweight yet strong, and can
withstand abrasion and wear.

[Electronics Industry]

### Electrical and Electronics Industry

Due to its good insulating properties, nylon is used in various electrical and electronic
applications such as circuit boards, connectors, wire insulation, and housing for electronic
devices.

[Construction Industry]

### Construction Industry

Nylon granules are used to manufacture plastic lumber, flooring underlays, pipes, conduits, and door
hardware. They offer good weather resistance, chemical resistance, and abrasion resistance.

[Textile Industry]

### Textiles and Apparel Industry

Nylon is a popular fiber used in clothing, carpets, and other textiles. Nylon granules are melted
and spun into fibers to create fabrics that are strong, durable, and wrinkle-resistant.

  * [Brand Values][89]
    As an established independent family owned company, we understand the industrial chemicals we
    supply and manufacture are an essential part of your businesses processes.
    
    Our acclaimed industry reputation is built on our core brand values which sets us apart from the
    competition.
    
    We understand industries and use our technical capability, advanced technology and established
    supply chain infrastructure to provide R&D and manufacturing solutions.
  * [History][90]
    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.
    
    The plot has been developed over the last 90 years, however some of the original rails can be
    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.
  * [Community][91]
    Over the years, Plater Group has promoted and sponsored many initiatives in support of local
    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.
    
    Local sporting clubs’ benefit from annual financial support, together with charities providing
    support to people living in neighbouring communities. The Plater Group team have taken part in
    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.

## About Us

Shakti Chemicals is a trusted name in the chemical import and distribution industry, committed to
delivering high-quality chemicals to businesses across various sectors. Established in 1998 by Mr.
Nehalkumar Gandhi, we have been at the forefront of connecting international chemical manufacturers
with the Indian market for over two decades. Based in Mumbai, we pride ourselves on our expertise,
reliability, and customer-centric approach. We specialize in sourcing and supplying premium-grade
chemicals that cater to a wide range of industries, ensuring superior quality and compliance with
global standards. Our extensive industry knowledge and strategic partnerships enable us to provide
tailored solutions that meet the specific needs of our clients.

Why Choose Us?
[image]

##### Quality Assurance

At Shakti Chemicals, quality is at the core of everything we do. We adhere to strict international
safety and quality standards, ensuring that every chemical we source, import, and distribute meets
the highest benchmarks. Our multi-level quality control process includes rigorous testing, supplier
audits, and compliance with regulatory frameworks such as REACH, ISO, and other industry
certifications. By maintaining a transparent and reliable supply chain, we guarantee the safety,
purity, and effectiveness of our products, fostering trust and long-term relationships with our
clients.

[image]

##### Commitment to Innovation

Innovation drives our business forward. We constantly explore new chemical solutions, advanced
sourcing strategies, and optimized supply chain models to enhance efficiency and reliability. Our
collaboration with leading research institutions, global manufacturers, and technology partners
allows us to bring cutting-edge products to the Indian market. Whether it's improving logistics,
enhancing product formulations, or adopting eco-friendly practices, we remain committed to staying
ahead in a dynamic industry.

[image]

##### Extensive Industry Experience

With over two decades of experience in the chemical trade industry, Shakti Chemicals has built a
strong reputation for expertise, reliability, and customer-centric service. Our deep understanding
of market trends, regulatory landscapes, and industry challenges enables us to provide tailored
solutions for businesses across diverse sectors. Over the years, we have established strong global
partnerships, expanded our distribution network, and continuously refined our operations to meet the
evolving needs of our clients.

* [Vision][30]
* [Values][31]

##### Our Mission

At Shakti Chemicals, our mission is to bridge the gap between global chemical manufacturers and the
Indian market by providing high-quality chemicals with exceptional service. We strive to foster
long-term partnerships through reliability, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.
1. Industry Leadership:
   
   To be a trusted and top-tier name in chemical distribution.
2. Integrity & Trust:
   
   To maintain the highest ethical standards in all our business dealings.
3. Global Expansion:
   
   To strengthen our presence in international markets.
4. Innovation & Sustainability:
   
   To continuously improve and adapt to industry advancements.

comprehensive chemical solutions since its establishment in 2011. With the continuous optimization

professional operations. Our products are widely used in various industries such as plastics,
rubber, coatings, textiles, inks, adhesives, etc. Our mission is to assist in scientific research

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.

# Revolutionizing Adipic Acid Production

#### Join us in creating a sustainable future for the apparel, automotive, and electronics
#### industries.

[ Learn More ][12]

### We are transforming the way adipic acid is made.

[ Contact us to learn more. ][13]

Our innovative bio-derived process not only makes adipic acid cleaner and cheaper but also
significantly reduces carbon emissions.

#### Our Solution for Evolving Adipic Acid Production.

UP Biochemicals offers a new way to produce adipic acid that is both environmentally friendly and
cost-effective. Our bio-derived process significantly reduces carbon emissions while maintaining the
high quality needed for nylon production.

#### Cleaner Production

UP Biochemicals makes adipic acid cleaner by utilizing a bio-derived process, as opposed to
traditional methods reliant on fossil fuels. This innovative approach significantly reduces carbon
emissions by 90%, minimizing the environmental impact associated with adipic acid production.

#### High-Quality Adipic Acid

UP’s proprietary catalyst technology precisely controls heat and mass transfer during the conversion
process. This advanced approach enhances reaction efficiency and purity, resulting in adipic acid
that meets the rigorous standards required for applications in textiles, automotive, and
electronics.

#### Affordable Nylon Production

Our adipic acid is more cost-effective than other green nylon alternatives due to its innovative
bio-derived process, significantly reducing production costs. Unlike fermentation-based methods,
which are often inefficient and expensive, UP Biochemicals’ proprietary catalyst technology ensures
high yields and purity with lower operational and separation costs.

[Columbus, OH Skyline]

Our first skid reactor plant will be located in Columbus, Ohio.

## Scaling Up Production

UP Biochemicals is committed to building a resilient and sustainable future for nylon production.
That’s why we are proud to utilize a domestic supply chain, ensuring ethical sourcing and supporting
American jobs. As we scale up manufacturing to meet the growing demand for our eco-friendly adipic
acid, we remain dedicated to minimizing our environmental footprint and providing our customers with
a reliable source of high-quality, domestically produced materials.

## Why Choose UP Biochemicals?

We redefine adipic acid production standards with our commitment to sustainability and innovation.

[Sustainability]

#### Sustainable Practices

Our technology reduces carbon emissions by over 90%, setting new environmental benchmarks.

[Cost-Effective]

#### Cost-Effective Solutions

We provide affordable, high-quality adipic acid to support diverse industries sustainably.

At UP Biochemicals, our mission is to revolutionize the production of adipic acid, making it
cleaner, more affordable, and environmentally friendly. We are committed to creating a green supply
chain that positively impacts the industries we serve.

About Us

Xuchuan Chemical was established in February 2007 with a registered capital of 500 million RMB . Its

Xuchuan Chemical(Suzhou) Co.,Ltd is a professionl manufacturer for PU System for Shoe Sole, Adhesive
for Shoes, TPU, CPU, [Polyester Polyol][133], PU Resin for Ink, [PUR Hot Melt Adhesive][134],
Adhesive for Flexible Package, [PU Resin For Synthetic Leather][135].

The company`s main products are polyester polyols, polyurethane resins for artificial leather,
[Polyurethane System For Shoe Sole][136] , polyurethane adhesives, polyurethane hot melt adhesives,
water-based polyurethane resins, solvent-free polyurethane resins and polyurethane elastomers,
covering a wide range of global civilian, industrial, and automotive applications Manufacturing,
medical equipment and other application fields, is a national high-tech enterprise specialized in
the research and development, production and sales of polyurethane resin products.
